title: Mystic Forest
description: This mod adds a new forest biome, with a purple wood set and a new flying hostile mob.
body:
This is a small vanilla plus-ish mod that adds one new biome with a new wood type and mob. 

The Mystic Forest is a new biome that can rarely be found in the overworld. It contains the new Mystic wood type that its respective stairs, slabs, logs, stripped logs, doors/trapdoors, fences, and buttons/pressure plates. 

The Mystic Forest is also home to the new Mystic Wisp, which can fly and is hostile towards players. 
There is also the new biolumenecent Mystic Mushroom. 

Planned future additions include signs and boats.
